title: Import from TV Time
introParagraph1: TV Time is shutting down on 07/15/2026 and has no public API. To bring your show and movie history here, officially export your data from the TV Time website and select the .zip file here — no need to extract anything, we'll take care of that.
introSteps:
1. Open the TV Time exporter and log in with your account.
2. Download the .zip file they email you.
3. Come back here and select that .zip.
